```{r define-paths}
OUT_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2/Updated"

RDS_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_RDS")
TABLE_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Tables")
MODEL_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Model")
PLOT_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Plots")

dir.create(RDS_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(TABLE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(MODEL_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(PLOT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

PREPARED_VIEW_MATRIX_FILE <- file.path(
  RDS_DIR,
  "MOFA2_prepared_input_view_matrices.rds"
)

# New filenames preserve the original six-factor model.
MODEL_TAG <- "K10_drop02_seed42"

MODEL_OUTFILE <- file.path(
  MODEL_DIR,
  paste0("MOFA2_updated_OncoKB_filtered_model_", MODEL_TAG, ".hdf5")
)

TRAINED_MODEL_RDS <- file.path(
  RDS_DIR,
  paste0("MOFA2_updated_OncoKB_filtered_model_", MODEL_TAG, "_trained.rds")
)
```

```{r load-and-check-input-views}
if (!file.exists(PREPARED_VIEW_MATRIX_FILE)) {
  stop("Prepared MOFA input file not found: ", PREPARED_VIEW_MATRIX_FILE)
}

view_mats <- readRDS(PREPARED_VIEW_MATRIX_FILE)

expected_views <- c(
  "RNA_VST_top5000var",
  "WES_CNV_numeric",
  "WES_mutation_recurrent",
  "IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB"
)

missing_views <- setdiff(expected_views, names(view_mats))

if (length(missing_views) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing expected input view(s): ",
    paste(missing_views, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Keep exactly the same four views and view order as the original model.
view_mats <- view_mats[expected_views]

valid_views <- vapply(view_mats, function(x) {
  is.matrix(x) && nrow(x) > 0 && ncol(x) > 0
}, logical(1))

if (!all(valid_views)) {
  stop(
    "Empty or invalid input view(s): ",
    paste(names(view_mats)[!valid_views], collapse = ", ")
  )
}

names(view_mats)
```

```{r summarize-input-views}
view_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) {
  mat <- view_mats[[v]]

  data.table(
    view = v,
    n_features = nrow(mat),
    n_samples = ncol(mat),
    n_non_missing_values = sum(is.finite(mat)),
    n_missing_values = sum(!is.finite(mat))
  )
}))

print(view_summary)

fwrite(
  view_summary,
  file.path(
    TABLE_DIR,
    paste0("MOFA2_training_input_view_summary_", MODEL_TAG, ".tsv")
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r sample-view-presence}
sample_view_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) {
  data.table(
    sample = colnames(view_mats[[v]]),
    view = v,
    present = 1
  )
}))

sample_summary <- dcast(
  sample_view_dt,
  sample ~ view,
  value.var = "present",
  fill = 0
)

view_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sample_summary), "sample")

sample_summary[
  ,
  n_views_present := rowSums(.SD),
  .SDcols = view_cols
]

sample_summary <- sample_summary[order(-n_views_present, sample)]

if (sample_summary[n_views_present >= 2, .N] == 0) {
  stop("No samples are shared across at least two views. Check sample IDs.")
}

print(sample_summary)

fwrite(
  sample_summary,
  file.path(
    TABLE_DIR,
    paste0("MOFA2_training_sample_view_presence_", MODEL_TAG, ".tsv")
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r convert-matrices-to-long-format}
matrix_to_long <- function(mat, view_name) {
  dt <- as.data.table(as.table(mat))
  setnames(dt, c("feature", "sample", "value"))

  dt[
    ,
    `:=`(
      sample = as.character(sample),
      feature = as.character(feature),
      view = view_name,
      value = as.numeric(value)
    )
  ]

  dt[is.finite(value), .(sample, feature, view, value)]
}

mofa_dt <- rbindlist(
  lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) {
    matrix_to_long(view_mats[[v]], v)
  }),
  use.names = TRUE
)

mofa_dt <- mofa_dt[, .(sample, feature, view, value)]

fwrite(
  mofa_dt,
  file.path(
    TABLE_DIR,
    paste0("MOFA2_training_input_long_format_", MODEL_TAG, ".tsv")
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

saveRDS(
  mofa_dt,
  file.path(
    RDS_DIR,
    paste0("MOFA2_training_input_long_format_", MODEL_TAG, ".rds")
  )
)

print(mofa_dt)
```

```{r create-mofa-object}
MOFAobject <- create_mofa(as.data.frame(mofa_dt))

print(MOFAobject)

pdf(
  file.path(
    PLOT_DIR,
    paste0("MOFA2_training_data_overview_", MODEL_TAG, ".pdf")
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 5
)

plot_data_overview(MOFAobject)
dev.off()
```

```{r define-data-model-and-training-options}
data_opts <- get_default_data_options(MOFAobject)

# RNA and CNV are Gaussian views; mutation views are Bernoulli 0/1 views.
# Keep binary mutation values unchanged.
data_opts$scale_views <- FALSE

model_opts <- get_default_model_options(MOFAobject)

# Start with a maximum of 10 factors.
model_opts$num_factors <- 10

view_likelihoods <- c(
  RNA_VST_top5000var = "gaussian",
  WES_CNV_numeric = "gaussian",
  WES_mutation_recurrent = "bernoulli",
  IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB = "bernoulli"
)

# Match likelihoods to the exact MOFA view order.
mofa_views <- names(model_opts$likelihoods)
view_likelihoods <- view_likelihoods[mofa_views]

if (anyNA(view_likelihoods)) {
  stop(
    "Could not match likelihoods to MOFA views. Current MOFA views: ",
    paste(mofa_views, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

model_opts$likelihoods <- view_likelihoods

train_opts <- get_default_training_options(MOFAobject)
train_opts$convergence_mode <- "medium"
train_opts$maxiter <- 1000
train_opts$verbose <- TRUE
train_opts$seed <- MODEL_SEED

# Automatically drop factors explaining <2% variance during training.
# 0.02 means 2% variance explained.
train_opts$drop_factor_threshold <- 0.02

print(data_opts)
print(model_opts)
print(train_opts)
```

```{r prepare-model}
MOFAobject <- prepare_mofa(
  object = MOFAobject,
  data_options = data_opts,
  model_options = model_opts,
  training_options = train_opts
)

print(MOFAobject)
```

```{r train-model}
MOFAobject.trained <- run_mofa(
  object = MOFAobject,
  outfile = MODEL_OUTFILE,
  use_basilisk = TRUE
)

saveRDS(MOFAobject.trained, TRAINED_MODEL_RDS)

print(MOFAobject.trained)
```

```{r trained-model-overview}
pdf(
  file.path(
    PLOT_DIR,
    paste0("MOFA2_trained_model_data_overview_", MODEL_TAG, ".pdf")
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 5
)

plot_data_overview(MOFAobject.trained)
dev.off()
```

```{r retained-factor-summary}
# The trained object printout also reports the retained factor number.
# Extract factor-score names for a machine-readable summary.
factor_scores <- get_factors(
  MOFAobject.trained,
  factors = "all",
  as.data.frame = TRUE
)

factor_scores <- as.data.table(factor_scores)

if (!"factor" %in% colnames(factor_scores)) {
  stop("Could not find column 'factor' in get_factors() output.")
}

retained_factors <- unique(as.character(factor_scores$factor))

factor_number <- suppressWarnings(
  as.integer(sub("^Factor", "", retained_factors))
)

retained_factors <- retained_factors[order(factor_number)]

factor_screen_summary <- data.table(
  Metric = c(
    "Initial maximum factors requested",
    "Automatic factor-drop threshold",
    "Number of retained factors after training",
    "Retained factor names",
    "Training seed"
  ),
  Value = c(
    10,
    "0.02 (2% variance explained)",
    length(retained_factors),
    paste(retained_factors, collapse = "; "),
    MODEL_SEED
  )
)

print(factor_screen_summary)

fwrite(
  factor_screen_summary,
  file.path(
    TABLE_DIR,
    paste0("MOFA2_factor_screening_summary_", MODEL_TAG, ".tsv")
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r final-training-summary}
training_summary <- data.table(
  Metric = c(
    "Number of views used for training",
    "Views used for training",
    "Number of unique samples across all views",
    "Number of samples present in at least two views",
    "Initial maximum factors requested",
    "Automatic factor-drop threshold",
    "Number of retained factors after training",
    "Retained factor names",
    "Model output file",
    "Trained model RDS file"
  ),
  Value = c(
    length(view_mats),
    paste(names(view_mats), collapse = "; "),
    uniqueN(mofa_dt$sample),
    sample_summary[n_views_present >= 2, .N],
    10,
    "0.02 (2% variance explained)",
    length(retained_factors),
    paste(retained_factors, collapse = "; "),
    MODEL_OUTFILE,
    TRAINED_MODEL_RDS
  )
)

print(training_summary)

fwrite(
  training_summary,
  file.path(
    TABLE_DIR,
    paste0("MOFA2_training_summary_", MODEL_TAG, ".tsv")
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)
```
